name: Remote Bootstrap
description: Non-blocking resolver for a server-owned remote namespace. Client code that calls WaitForChild on a remote folder directly from an initializer stalls its entire thread when the server has not replicated yet - and stalls forever when the server script is absent, producing a frozen interface with no error. This component resolves a dotted remote path on a detached thread with a per-hop timeout, caches the result, and hands the caller either the resolved remote or an explicit miss so it can proceed on defaults. Makes 'server not ready' a normal branch instead of a hang.

implementations.note: Resolution is injected, so the resolver is testable against a fake tree with no DataModel.

provenance: Surfaced by the same defect pass (2026-09-11): eight of nine UI modules opened with a synchronous ReplicatedStorage WaitForChild on a remote folder whose server script was absent, stalling each thread permanently and leaving a frozen interface with no error raised. Searched first: persistence.datastore_safe retries datastore calls rather than resolving remotes, utility.command_bus assumes its transport already exists, and social.trade_remote_handler owns one remote it is handed; nothing owns the client-side handshake that decides a remote never arrived. Library-native, written against ReplicatedStorage replication timing.
